description: Every component the service plans, runs, compiles and converts through: the simulation methods, the compiler passes, the noise channels and the program formats, each with its version, its origin and the BLAKE3 digest of its descriptor, which is the identity a result is sealed with. The service runs the built-ins alone and never loads a component from a request.
name: list_components

anyOf.description: Every component the engine plans, runs, compiles and converts through (engine::registry::Registry::components): the simulation methods, the compiler passes, the noise channels and the program formats, each in the registry's order with its identity and its descriptor. The command line, both MCP servers and the job service serve the built-ins alone.

certified.description: Beside a registered component: the engine does not certify it.

descriptor.description: What the component declares of itself, as hashed into its digest: what it declares (declared) and what the engine reads of it (a method's accuracy classes, whether it models noise, where auto tries it; a pass's gates taken and given and its check; a channel's arity, placement and parameters; a format's title, extensions and profiles).

digest.description: BLAKE3 of the component's descriptor in its canonical JSON (engine::registry::digest_of).

origin.description: built-in: the engine's own; registered: a host's own, added in its process, not part of the engine.
